title: eo search --format json — one product
description: Emitted by `eo search --format json` (src/eosdk/cli/commands/search.py), which prints JSON Lines: ONE LINE = ONE PRODUCT. This schema therefore describes a single product record, not the stream — validate each line separately. The record is Product.model_dump_json() (src/eosdk/models.py::Product) and is exactly what `eo download -` reads back from stdin, so it is byte-compatible with `eo get --json`. Hand-written on purpose: it is a contract, not a projection of the model, so a model change shows up as a failing test instead of a silently regenerated schema. `additionalProperties` is true — downstream consumers must tolerate fields added later.

id.description: Backend-native product identifier; the reference `eo download`/`eo get`/`eo list --via http` accept.

name.description: Product name as the catalogue advertises it (the download filename stem).

collection.description: Collection the product belongs to; null when the backend does not say.

size.description: Size of the downloadable payload in bytes; null when unknown.

geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry of the product footprint; null when the backend does not say.

datetime.description: Acquisition instant, RFC 3339. Serialized by pydantic from a timezone-aware datetime.

cloud_cover.description: Cloud cover in percent, where the collection carries it.

s3_path.description: Address of the product root in object storage, in either vocabulary the S3 backend accepts: an `s3://bucket/key` URI (STAC) or an absolute `/bucket/key` path (OData). Null when the catalogue advertises no S3 location; `eo ... --via s3` then cannot address the product.

raw.description: The untouched backend document the product was normalized from (a STAC item or an OData entry). Structure is backend-specific by design and deliberately unconstrained here.

checksum.description: Catalogue-advertised checksum of the downloadable payload; null when the backend advertises none, in which case `--checksum` cannot verify anything.

value.description: Lower-case hex digest (normalized by the model).
